title: Quantifying Structure in CLIP Embeddings: A Statistical Framework for Concept Interpretation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy and accuracy gaps on zero-shot classification tasks across datasets with known spurious correlations (Waterbirds, iWildCam, and CelebA) after identifying and zeroing out concept embeddings associated with spurious dataset attributes like backgrounds, camera locations, and co-occurring features (eyeglasses).
